name: ZOUR x BITEZ Micros 3,000MG Gummies - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP - Watermelon Lemonade
description: Watermelon Lemonade delivers a refreshing balance of sweet and tart citrus flavor. Juicy watermelon pairs with bright, zesty lemonade for a fruity combination that starts sweet and finishes with a tangy citrus note. This Ocho Extracts x Zour Stash collab packs a 500mg Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP blend per gummy—half the potency of the original BITEZ for a smoother, more manageable experience (6 gummies per bag, 3,000mg total). Sweet watermelon and tangy lemonade create a refreshing finish in every bite.
